children: Nordic markets are seen opening slightly higher with IG calling the OMXS30 up 0.4% at around 3284. Brent crude hit $108 yesterday, but has since fallen by around $2 following reports that the U.S. and Iran are discussing a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, SEB macro strategist Gustav Helgesson writes. The global rise in bond yields continues, particularly in the U.S., where the 10-year yield touched 5.2% yesterday and the 30-year reached 5.5%, he adds. "Despite an unusually warm reception, there were few new concrete agreements during China's first state visit to the U.S. in ten years." U.S. and European equity futures point to a positive opening. OMXS30 closed at 3271.26, OMXN40 at 2614.61, and OBX at 2012.06. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
